agreements.reason: This is a current-code product master with no old-code history. I agree it cannot serve N2 and that its names alone do not support a join, so the N2 gap is real and not a pipeline artefact.
Nager covers national holidays only. I agree the local patron-saint day stays unmet under N4 and needs a human-supplied source.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If Retail Operations supplies a complete old-to-new product code list for the 2023 to 2026 sales history, the product master would become a join source and N2 could move from unmet to met with conditions.
